step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows Deep Instinct agents sending requests to AWS CloudFront. CloudFront executes Lambda@Edge Viewer Request functions which write real-time statistics and agent upgrade tracking data into two DynamoDB tables. CloudFront interacts with an S3 bucket as its origin to retrieve files, and a Lambda@Edge Origin Response function manipulates responses before returning them to clients.

graph.name: Deep Instinct Real-time Statistics and Agent Upgrades with Lambda@Edge
graph.notes: Architecture uses Lambda@Edge at Viewer Request and Origin Response triggers with DynamoDB and S3.
